about.title: Grey wolf (Canis lupus) skull and mandible: measurements, jaw-joint geometry, gape estimate and outlines from two MRI PAS CT/3D scans
about.units: mm unless stated; angles in degrees, included angle between upper and lower jaw (0 = closed)
about.frame_3d: anatomical, right-handed: x forward (rostral), y up (dorsal), z = the animal RIGHT side. Origin = hinge centre (midpoint of the two mandibular condyle centres) at closed jaw. Palate plane (midline oral surface of the hard palate) is horizontal (y const). Midsagittal plane is z = 0. Flip the sign of z if you need z = left (that frame is left-handed).
about.frame_side_2d: lateral projection drawn facing right with image y DOWN: X = x - x_prosthion (forward +), Y = -(y - y_prosthion) (down +). Origin = prosthion. "cbl" values are the same divided by that wolf's condylobasal length.
about.frame_dorsal_2d: dorsal view facing right, image y down: X as above, Y = z (animal right side = down in the image). Origin X = prosthion, Y = midsagittal plane.
about.outline_method: all triangles of a decimated copy (300k skull / 200k mandible faces) projected, rasterised at 0.25 mm, closed ~1 mm, holes filled, largest region kept, outer contour by marching squares (scikit-image find_contours), Douglas-Peucker simplified at 0.5 mm (shapely). Same method as ref/research/fetched/03-dog-model (which used 0.5 mm raster, 1 mm tolerance).
about.confidence: measurements from automatic landmarks: B (one specimen each; landmarks are mesh extremes inside stated regions). Items marked _EST were read by eye from renders (+-2-3 mm) or are model estimates.

170753.citation: Mammal Research Institute, Polish Academy of Sciences (2020). Canis lupus - 170753, Zoological collection of the Mammal Research Institute, PAS. Open Forest Data. doi:10.48370/OFD/LVT9AC
170753.units_check: STL units are mm: CBL 244.3 mm (expected about 230-260)
170753.closed_pose: articulated scan pose from file 23962, hinged 2.0 deg open about the condyle axis because the incisors interpenetrated up to 2.6 mm; the canines and carnassials were already in occlusion

condylobasal_length.definition: prosthion to caudal-most point of the occipital condyles, along the palate-parallel x axis (vdD 2 analogue)

skull_height_above_palate.definition: highest point of the cranium (sagittal crest) above the palate plane, perpendicular to it

skull_height_total_with_canines.definition: vertical extent of the skull (no mandible) with the palate horizontal, including upper canine tips

palate_length.definition: staphylion (caudal palate border, midline) to prosthion along x (vdD 16 median palatal length)

snout_length_EST.definition: rostral orbital margin (read from render, +-2 mm) to prosthion along x (vdD 8 analogue)

neurocranium_length_EST.definition: basion to nasion (vdD 5); nasion taken on the dorsal midline above the rostral orbital margin (suture not visible on the scan)

orbit_width_side_view_EST.definition: lateral projection, postorbital processes/ligament line to rostral rim, read from render

orbit_height_side_view_EST.definition: lateral projection, frontal rim to zygomatic arch top, read from render

mandible_length_condyle.definition: caudal surface of the condylar process to infradentale, along x at closed jaw (vdD 1)

mandible_length_angular.definition: angular process (gonion caudale) to infradentale along x (vdD 2)

mandible_height_ramus.definition: gonion ventrale to coronion, vertical in the closed pose (vdD 19 analogue)

upper_canine_tip_below_palate.definition: upper canine tip below the palate plane

lower_canine_tip_above_infradentale.definition: lower canine tip height above infradentale, closed pose

tmj_above_palate.definition: condyle (hinge) centre height relative to the palate plane

tmj_behind_prosthion.definition: condyle (hinge) centre distance behind prosthion along x

gape.method: mandible rotated about the axis through the two condyle centres (pure hinge, no translation) in 1 deg steps; contact = >=0.3 mm overlap between mandible vertices and the skull surface (nearest-vertex signed distance; condyle region within 12 mm of the condyle centres excluded)
gape.bony_contact_where: caudal border of the ramus / angular process meets the retroarticular process and external acoustic meatus region; the coronoid process never touches the zygomatic arch (it swings forward inside the arch)
gape.condyle_leaves_glenoid: not reached in a pure hinge model; the condyle stays seated by construction

muscle_line_check.note: straight line from a temporalis origin on the sagittal crest (x = -50 mm in the palate frame, i.e. mid temporal fossa) to the coronoid tip; angle at which the line reaches 1.5x and 1.7x its closed length, [right, left]. 1.7x is the often-quoted fibre-stretch limit used in jaw-gape models (Herring & Herring 1974; recalled, not verified here). The superficial masseter line (rostral zygomatic arch to angular process) never reached 1.3x below 120 deg.

170555.citation: Mammal Research Institute, Polish Academy of Sciences (2022). Canis lupus - 170555, Zoological collection of the Mammal Research Institute, PAS. Open Forest Data. doi:10.48370/OFD/LNRMXW
170555.collected: 2013-10-07, Bialowieza National Park (European bison Show Reserve), Poland
170555.units_check: STL units are mm: CBL 226.2 mm (expected about 230-260)
170555.closed_pose: the scan file 42560 has the mandible dropped about 15-20 mm (not articulated). Fitted: similarity ICP of skull and mandible onto wolf 170753, glenoid centres transferred from 170753, condyle centres moved onto them (5.3 mm shift, 1.2 deg turn), lowered 0.6 mm until no condyle-fossa overlap, then hinged to first tooth contact (-0.25 deg). Lower canines are broken, so closure is set by incisor and cheek-tooth contact. FITTED, not as found.
